About Us

We're in the early (idea) stage of development and are looking for a hands on AI/ML expert to join as a founding engineer in this journey.

Role Overview

ASR & Speech Processing
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy ASR models (Whisper, wav2vec2, NeMo, or equivalent) for telephony audio across multiple languages and accents.
Build preprocessing pipelines: voice activity detection (VAD), noise suppression, audio normalization, handling for low-fidelity channels (compressed IVR, mobile).
Instrument ASR evaluation: measure WER on domain-specific test sets, identify failure modes (accent drift, domain vocabulary gaps), and propose targeted fine-tuning strategies.

Speaker Diarization & Attribution
Build end-to-end diarization systems that identify speaker boundaries, extract speaker embeddings, and cluster utterances to speakers.
Handle challenging scenarios: overlapping speech, short speaker turns, similar voices, noisy backgrounds.
Integrate diarization with ASR output, ensure each transcribed segment is correctly attributed to the speaker.

Post-Transcription NLP & Conversation Analysis
Design and evaluate intent classification models: purchase intent, complaints, escalations, policy violations, compliance triggers.
Implement sentiment and emotion extraction, tracking per-speaker turn and identifying call trajectory (positive -> negative or vice versa).
Build compliance detection pipelines: automatic PII/PHI redaction (using model-based approaches, not regex), regulatory language flagging (e.g., HIPAA, FCA regulations), and audit trail generation.
Architect LLM orchestration: decide when to fine-tune vs. prompt-engineer, which model (GPT-4, Claude, open-source) for each task, and implement guardrails against hallucinations.
Evaluate LLM outputs rigorously: factuality scoring, hallucination detection (using LLM-as-a-judge or perturbation methods), consistency checks.

Required Technical Skills

Speech Technologies (Deep Expertise)
ASR Models & Frameworks: Production experience with Whisper, wav2vec2, NVIDIA NeMo, or Conformer-based systems.
Diarization: Implemented speaker diarization pipelines (NeMo, pyannote.audio, or custom); understands embedding extraction, clustering algorithms (spectral clustering, DBSCAN), and failure modes.
Forced Alignment: Familiar with word-level timestamp generation (WhisperX, Kaldi, or custom wav2vec2 approaches).
Evaluation Metrics: Can articulate and measure WER, DER, WDER, speaker count error, latency (p50/p90/p99), and MOS. Can design custom metrics for domain-specific tasks.

NLP & Language Models
Fine-tuning vs. Prompt Engineering: Can decide which approach for a given task. Experience fine-tuning BERT, RoBERTa, or GPT models for text classification, NER, or intent detection.
Intent Classification & Sentiment Analysis: Built production intent classifiers (not just toy examples). Understands handling of overlapping intents, multi-label classification, and low-resource scenarios.
Prompt Engineering & RAG: Can design effective prompts, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and iterate on output quality without retraining.
RLHF & Guardrails: Familiar with reinforcement learning from human feedback; can implement output filters, constraint-based decoding, or custom scoring functions to prevent hallucinations.
Multi-LLM Orchestration: Experience evaluating and routing between models based on task, cost, latency, and quality. Can implement fallback strategies and cost optimization.

Production Systems & MLOps
Model Deployment: Shipped models to production using Docker, Kubernetes, KServe, or similar. Can reason about inference latency, throughput, and cost.
Data Pipelines: Built ETL/ELT pipelines for training and inference. Experience with distributed processing (Spark, Airflow, or Beam) for batch ASR.

Programming & Tools
Languages: Expert-level Python; comfortable with Go, JavaScript, or C++ for performance-critical components.
ML Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow; experience with HuggingFace Transformers library.
Audio Processing: librosa, scipy, or equivalent. Understand spectral analysis, MFCC, log-mel spectrograms, and waveform manipulation.
Distributed Computing: Experience with distributed training (PyTorch DDP, TensorFlow distributed) and batch processing.
Cloud Platforms: Comfortable with AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker, Lambda) or GCP/Azure equivalents.

Domain Knowledge (Conversation Intelligence)
Real-world call audio: Worked with actual phone recordings; understands IVR, codec compression (G.711, Opus), background noise, accent variation.
Telephony constraints: Understands PSTN latency, streaming vs. batch processing, and sub-second processing requirements.
Multilingual systems: Built ASR or NLP systems for non-English languages or code-switched speech (e.g., Hindi-English, Tamil-English).
Compliance: Familiar with HIPAA, PCI DSS, or GDPR requirements; understands sensitive data handling, audit trails, and redaction strategies.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Multilingual ASR: Trained or fine-tuned models for Indic languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi), Mandarin, or other languages.
Domain-Specific Language Models: Built custom language models for specialized vocabulary (medical, legal, financial).
Acoustic Adaptation: Implemented speaker or environment adaptation techniques to improve model robustness.
Reinforcement Learning: Trained models using RLHF or other RL techniques; experience with preference learning.
MLOps Infrastructure: Built end-to-end ML platforms: feature stores (Feast, Tecton), model registries, automated retraining pipelines.
Cloud Cost Optimization: Optimized ML workloads for cost (spot instances, batch scheduling, inference optimization).
Distributed Systems: Designed and debugged distributed training or inference systems; familiar with failure modes and debugging strategies.
Research Publication: Published research in speech, NLP, or conversational AI (venues like Interspeech, ACL, NeurIPS); maintains active engagement with the research community.
Open-Source Contribution: Contributed meaningfully to speech/NLP open-source projects (NeMo, Hugging Face, pyannote.audio).
Regulatory Knowledge: Familiar with HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, FCA, or India TRAI requirements; can design compliant systems.

At least 1-2 years working with speech recognition, NLP, or multimodal systems (not just generic ML).
Shipped production ML systems (not research code, not Kaggle competitions). You have debugged performance issues in the wild.

A Data Scientist with expertise in Artificial Intelligence is a professional who skilfully combines data analysis and business acumen to tackle cognitive computing challenges. They are proficient in advanced analytics techniques for structured data and have a deep understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) methods for unstructured content. They are specialized in foundation models and large language models and skilled in architecting and delivering AI solutions using cutting-edge technologies, with a strong focus on foundation models and large language models. In this role, you will be responsible for architecting and delivering AI solutions using cutting-edge technologies, with a strong focus on foundation models and large language models, along with Experience in tools like GitHub Copilot, Amazon Code Whisperer. This expertise enables them to create comprehensive cognitive solutions that effectively process and analyse both structured and unstructured data. The professional should also have a strong foundation in one of the following areas: NLP, Image Processing, Video Processing, Voice Processing, or Watson technologies. This skill set is valuable in solving complex business problems and leveraging the power of artificial intelligence for cognitive computing. They have strong programming skills, with proficiency in Python and experience with AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras or Hugging Face; understanding in the usage of libraries such as SciKit Learn, Pandas, Matplotlib, etc; familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP) and related services. Beyond the initial build, you will design sophisticated lead-scoring algorithms and deploy AI agents to enrich our database with automated web-gathering and "next-phase" intelligence.
This is a "builder" role for someone who enjoys the intersection of traditional data engineering and modern agentic AI.
Key Responsibilities:
Data Architecture: Build and maintain scalable REST API integrations using Azure Data Factory (ADF) to pull diverse companies and contact datasets into a centralized environment.
Identity Resolution: Design and implement complex "waterfall" deduplication logic in T-SQL to match entities using composite keys (e.g., Phone, Address, Web Metadata) when unique IDs are missing.
Lead Scoring Logic: Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to develop and deploy multi-factor lead scoring models within the database to prioritize high-value prospects.
AI Agent Development: Design and deploy AI Agents (using frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or Azure OpenAI) to crawl the web and social media for real-time data enrichment and intent signals.
CRM & Workflow Automation: Ensure the "Gold" records and lead scores are synced seamlessly via "Upsert" logic to the CRM, triggering automated sales workflows.
Product Evolution: Roadmap the "next phase" of functionality, including predictive modeling, churn analysis, and automated outreach triggers.
Required Technical Skills:
Advanced T-SQL & Azure SQL: Mastery of window functions, fuzzy matching, and stored procedure automation within the Azure SQL (Serverless) ecosystem.
Modern AI Stack: Experience integrating LLMs (Azure OpenAI/GPT-4) and building Agentic workflows for data extraction and summarization.
Azure Data Factory: Expert-level knowledge of ADF for complex data orchestration and Key Vault for secure credential management.
Python (for AI): Proficiency in Python for writing custom data scraping scripts and managing AI agent logic.
Lead Scoring Frameworks: Ability to build weighted mathematical models based on data density, recency, and activity.
The Ideal Candidate Thinks Like This:
"I’ll build the SQL foundation first, but I’m designing it to store the unstructured data our AI agents will find later."
"Lead scoring shouldn't just be based on size; it should include the 'intent signals' our agents scrape from the web."
"I prefer to automate data gathering so our database stays fresh without manual intervention."
Preferred Experience:
Prior experience in a startup or "Phase 1" environment where you were responsible for the initial architecture.
Experience with Beautiful Soup, Selenium, or Playwright for web-based data gathering.
Background in B2B data analytics or Sales Operations technology.
How this changes the hiring profile:
By adding "AI Agents" and "Lead Scoring," you are now looking for a candidate with Python skills in addition to SQL.
SQL will be their "Warehouse" language.
Python will be their "AI/Scraping" language.

Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazons AWS cloud services? Amazons Payroll Tax & Accounting Technology team is looking for a results-oriented, driven Software Development Engineer who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable gross-to-net calculation infrastructure with sophisticated tax processing at its core. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex regulatory contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. A Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Amazon works on real world problems on a global scale, owns their systems end to end and influences the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions of customers around the world. You can expect to design flexible and scalable solutions, and work on some of the most complex challenges in large-scale computing by utilizing your skills in data structures, algorithms, and object oriented programming. Coming to Amazon gives you the opportunity to work on a small development team in one of our many rapidly growing organizations.

You will learn all about how to design, implement and test highly scalable solutions using AWS cloud platform and its many products, in challenging agile projects, working with best in class professionals.

Build a globally deployed, locally configured gross-to-net calculation engine that leverages LLM-based rule extraction to formalize complex jurisdiction-specific tax regulations, including multi-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and statutory compliance requirements
Design and develop deterministic tax calculation algorithms that handle employee withholding, employer tax obligations, and process gross earnings through deductions to calculate net pay across multiple countries

Create accounting integration services that generate GL entries and journal entries for all necessary payroll entries, like earnings, tax, & benefits
Implement GenAI shadow mode validation frameworks to ensure accuracy against existing systems
Partner directly with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Technical Program Managers, tax specialists, and payroll operations teams to understand features and continuously identify opportunities to build and deploy software solutions

Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazons global payroll tax calculation and gross-to-net accounting needs
Raise the bar on code quality, including security, auditability, readability, consistency, and maintainability
Leverage GenAI capabilities to build validation frameworks and continuously improve system accuracy

Youll start your morning collaborating with tax specialists and payroll operations teams across multiple countries to understand jurisdiction-specific requirements. title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
The Director of Software Engineering will lead and scale critical areas of software engineering for Diligent within our Technology Centre of Excellence. This role is deeply technology-focused , combining hands-on technical depth with strategic leadership to drive the design, development, and delivery of industry-leading products across the Diligent portfolio.
As a senior technology leader, the Director will set long-term engineering strategy and roadmaps , align technology investments with business priorities, and collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, Data, AI, Security, and other cross-functional partners to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

In addition to strong software engineering leadership, this role will champion Diligent s transformation into an AI-first organization identifying opportunities where artificial intelligence can accelerate innovation, enhance customer experience, and unlock new business models. The Director will serve as a senior technical authority, embedding AI fluency, experimentation, and strategic foresight into engineering practices and decision-making.

Provide strategic and technical leadership across software engineering domains, leading leaders and high-performing teams at scale.
Own and drive the technology vision, multi-year roadmaps, and execution strategy , ensuring alignment with Diligent s business objectives and AI-native direction.
Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, AI, Security, and other stakeholders to prioritize initiatives , balance trade-offs, and deliver outcomes across complex, cross-functional programs.
Translate company goals and portfolio strategy into clear, actionable engineering plans , communicating priorities, dependencies, and progress effectively at all levels.
Actively track emerging technologies and AI advancements, assessing their relevance and strategically integrating them into products, platforms, and engineering processes .
Champion AI-first and technology-led thinking , challenging conventional approaches and driving innovative, scalable solutions.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence , encouraging rapid learning and innovation.
Ensure responsible AI adoption, maintaining awareness of risk, ethics, and resilience while scaling AI capabilities.
Develop deep customer and domain understanding, ensuring technology decisions are grounded in customer value and long-term impact.

Build, mentor, and retain strong engineering leadership, creating a high-trust, high-performance environment.

15+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience leading large, complex engineering organizations and managing managers.

Experience operating in globally distributed teams and fast-growing organizations preferred.

description:

Experience: 5+ years of industry experience developing forecasting models, preferably for energy systems and electricity markets.
Forecasting Model Development: Design, develop, deploy, and maintain advanced statistical and machine learning models for time series forecasting, with applications in demand, price, and renewable energy prediction. Incorporate probabilistic scenario generation to characterize uncertainty in forecasts.
Advanced Forecasting Techniques: Leverage ensemble-based forecasting methods and develop self-correcting models of models that iteratively improve forecast accuracy by dynamically integrating feedback and error correction mechanisms.

Multivariate Time-Series Modeling and Dependence Structure Analysis : Implement advanced stochastic modeling frameworks to capture the dependence structure of temporal and spatial correlations in time-series data across a sequence of markets, ensuring realistic scenario generation that reflects the complex relationships and dynamics within and between markets.

Data Engineering: Design robust ETL pipelines and define database schemas to streamline data ingestion, preprocessing, and storage, ensuring seamless integration into forecasting workflows.

Microservices Architecture: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating microservices-based systems, including service decomposition, API design, inter-service communication, scalability, fault tolerance, and observability within cloud-native environments.
Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Monitor deployed models and workflows to ensure reliability, scalability, and optimal performance. Continuously refine and improve systems to meet evolving requirements.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including optimization engineering experts, software engineers, and product stakeholders, to ensure smooth integration of forecasting systems into broader applications.
What will our ideal candidate bring to Fluence
Time Series Expertise: Strong understanding of time series forecasting techniques, including statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and deep learning approaches.
Uncertainty Characterization: Expertise in implementing stochastic processing models to generate probabilistic forecast scenarios that characterize uncertainty in time series data.
Multivariate Time-Series Modeling: Experience developing stochastic frameworks that capture temporal and spatial correlations across markets, ensuring realistic and robust scenario generation.
Advanced Forecasting Techniques: Familiarity with ensemble-based methods and self-correcting forecasting models that improve through iterative feedback.
Forecasting Experience: 7+ years of industry experience developing forecasting models, preferably to address bidding and dispatch challenges in electricity markets.
Energy Industry Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of the energy industry, with a focus on deregulated electricity markets such as NEM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, PJM, and Japan.
Programming and Software Practices: Advanced proficiency in Python for feature engineering, model development, training, and forecasting, with strong knowledge of modern software development practices, including version control (Git), testing frameworks, and agile methodologies.
Cloud and Infrastructure: Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions), containerization tools like Docker, container orchestration using Kubernetes, and managing workflows for large-scale data and model pipelines.
ETL and Data Management: Proven experience in designing ETL pipelines, creating efficient data schemas, and managing data flows at scale.
CI/CD Pipelines: Hands-on experience with continuous integration and delivery tools to automate and streamline model and software deployment.
Agile/Lean Product Development: Experience working and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, demonstrating adaptability and efficient collaboration.
Collaboration Skills: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and build strong working relationships across disciplines.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse stakeholders.

Knowledge/ Skill Requirement

A Network Customer Success Engineer is responsible for ensuring that enterprise-level customers have a positive experience with their switch and router networking services. They work to address customer issues, identify areas for improvement, and provide guidance and support to customers as needed. Here are some primary and secondary skills that are important for a Network Customer Success Engineer:

Experience Level: 4-8 Years


1. Networking Expertise: The engineer should have strong technical skills and knowledge of L2/L3 switching and routing systems and technologies, including security, tunnelling and network service protocols and Quality of Service (QoS) networking. Relevant industry certifications, such as CCNP (routing and switching) is strongly preferred.
2. Network design and configuration: The engineer should be able to design and configure switching networks that meet the customers business requirements and align with industry best practices. This may involve installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of network equipment, such as switches, routers, and security gateway.

Troubleshooting: The engineer should be able to troubleshoot network issues and identify problems with the network infrastructure, including connectivity, configuration, VLAN, STP, port security and Quality of Service (QoS). They should also be able to use network monitoring tools and protocols such as Wireshark, Zabbix and Nagios.
5. Communication skills: The engineer should have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. They should be able to explain technical issues and solutions to non-technical customers and collaborate effectively with other internal teams, such as sales and product management.
6. Customer Service Skills: The engineer should have strong customer service skills, including the ability to handle customer complaints and inquiries professionally and efficiently.
7. Problem-Solving Skills: The engineer should be able to identify and solve complex technical issues and think creatively to find solutions to problems.

title: TAC Engineer - Fixed Wireless
description:
A Fixed Wireless Customer Success Engineer is responsible for ensuring that T1/T2/T3 Service Provider customers have a positive experience with their outdoor Fixed Wireless Broadband Point-To-Multipoint (PMP) and Point-To-Point (PTP) deployments. They work to address customer issues, identify areas for improvement, and provide guidance and support to customers as needed. Here are some primary and secondary skills that are important for a Fixed Wireless Customer Success Engineer:

Primary Skills:
1. Fixed Wireless Access: The engineer should have strong technical skills and knowledge of outdoor PMP and PTP Licensed and Unlicensed Fixed Wireless Access systems. They should be familiar with RF fundamentals, Frequency capability, Channel Bandwidth, Modulation Schemes, Transmission Methods, Microwave propagation (Factor s, LOS/nLOS/NLOS, Fresnel zone, FSPL, Fading). They should be familiar with the various standards, protocols, and technologies used in wireless networking, such as 3GPPP, IEEE 802.11 and licensed microwave technologies.
2. Network design and configuration: The engineer should be able to design and configure outdoor fixed wireless networks that meet the customers business requirements and align with industry best practices. This may involve conducting link budget planning, site surveys, selecting appropriate equipment, and configuring wireless network equipment, such as base stations/access points, CPE/Subscriber Modules and associated tower-related equipment such as switches/routers, power supplies, and surge protection units. Knowledge of outdoor tower/rooftop-based deployments is important.
3. Security: The engineer should be knowledgeable in wireless security protocols and best practices. They should be able to configure and manage wireless security features such as authentication, encryption, and access control.
4. Troubleshooting: The engineer should be able to troubleshoot network issues and identify problems with the outdoor network infrastructure, including signal interference, device connectivity, and network performance. They should also be able to use network monitoring tools and protocols such as Wireshark and packet crafting to diagnose and resolve issues.
5. Communication skills: The engineer should have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. They should be able to explain technical issues and solutions to non-technical customers and collaborate effectively with other internal teams, such as sales and product management.
6. Customer Service Skills: The engineer should have strong customer service skills, including the ability to handle customer complaints and inquiries professionally and efficiently. Deliver high-quality technical assistance to customers via phone call, remote session, email, and chat support. Receive, investigate, resolve, track, or dispatch trouble tickets in a timely manner.

Secondary Skills:
1. Networking Expertise: The engineer should have strong technical skills and knowledge of L2/L3 switching and routing systems and technologies, including understanding of TCP windowing/handshake, UDP, VoIP/SIP and other packet protocols. Ability to analyse packet captures and use tools such as Ping, Traceroute, Wireshark is necessary.
2. Technical documentation: The engineer should be able to create and maintain technical documentation, such as network diagrams, configuration files, and network topology maps.
3. Analytical Skills: The engineer should have strong analytical skills to analyze data, identify trends, and make recommendations for improvements.
4. Collaboration Skills: The engineer may work with a team of other technical professionals internally and externally, so strong collaboration skills are important.

3 to 8 years of experience in outdoor fixed wireless technologies covering licensed and unlicensed PMP/PTP, 4G/5G RAN and related telecom technologies. Knowledge of RF fundamentals and concepts, outdoor wireless propagation, link budget, L2 and L3 protocol and security and, Quality of Service (QoS) networking preferred. Prior experience either as a Solution Architect or Network Design Engineer or Customer Success Engineer is preferred.

Education requirements for a Customer Success Engineer are a minimum bachelors degree in computer science or a related field, along with relevant industry certifications, such as 4G/5G RAN, CCNP (routing and switching) and CWNE are preferred.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
Job Posting Title: Data Scientist
Location: UniOps Bangalore,
About Unilever:
Be part of the world s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we ll work to help you become a better you.
Background:
For Unilever to remain competitive in the future, the business needs to continue on the path to become data intelligent. The Data & Analytics team will persevere to make Unilever Data Intelligent, powering key decisions with data, insights, advanced analytics and AI. Our ambition is to enable democratization of data, information and insights as a completely agile organization that builds fantastic careers for our people and is accountable for delivering great work that maximizes impact and delivers growth.
This Data & Analytics function endeavours to create clear accountability for all aspects of Data Strategy, Data Management, Information Management, Analytics, and Insights. We are accountable for impact of solutions, maintaining market relevance and minimising unnecessary overlaps in analytics products, ensuring simplicity and that our solutions better meet the needs of our users. We partner with the Digital and Data Legal Counsel to ensure that our Data Defence (Privacy, Governance, Quality, etc) is well structured and sufficiently robust to use data and AI correctly throughout the enterprise. We democratize information across the business, while supporting the culture shift required for data driven decision making.
Our vision is to make Unilever data intelligent, partnering with the business to power key decisions with data, advanced analytics and AI to accelerate growth. Our 5 strategies to achieve this are:
Accelerate & simplify access to relevant data, information and insights Build in-house, leading-edge data, information, insights & analytics capability Lead the data & insights culture and careers to empower employees across Unilever Rapidly embed analytics products, solutions and services to drive growth Advance Information Automation at Scale
The Data Scientist role sit within the Customer Operations XOPS team . This team builds state of the art machine learning algorithms, maximising the impact of D&A s solutions in driving enterprise performance. Typical initiatives include optimizing trade promotion investments, accurately forecasting customer demand, using NLP to glean insight on consumer trends from search data, and making individual assortment recommendations for each of the millions of stores that sell Unilever products. The role will work closely with a D&A functional team such as Customer Development or Supply Chain along with business stakeholders, addressing both large transformation programs and near-term business problems.
Main Purpose of the Job:
The Data Scientist improves business performance in the functional area of Unilever they serve, through the application of world class data science capability. They support delivery of data science on a range of projects.
Key accountabilities:
With guidance from the Senior/Lead Data Scientist, understand business challenges and the planned data science solutions
Contribute refinements to the plan through your own data science knowledge
Prototype experimental solutions, particularly machine learning models
Where required, support the build of scaled solutions
Facilitate industrialization and ongoing operation of solutions through well organised code, clear documentation and collaboration with ML Ops resources
Interact with stakeholder teams, clearly communicating relevant data science issues
Support your data science peers with technical advice in your areas of expertise
Support the growth of D&A s data science capability by contributing to activities such as tool and vendor selection, best practice definition, recruitment, and creation of training materials

description:
As a Senior Data Engineer in Bangalore, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world s payments ecosystem!
This purpose of this role is:
The Senior Data Engineer plays a critical role in enabling ACIs data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities by designing, building, and maintaining the organizations Databricks-based Data Lake infrastructure.
 This position is responsible for creating scalable, high-performance data pipelines that transform raw data into valuable insights, supporting data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders across the enterprise. By implementing robust data engineering solutions and best practices, this role ensures that ACI has access to reliable, timely, and high-quality data to support strategic initiatives, product innovation, and operational excellence. The Senior Data Engineer contributes directly to ACIs mission by empowering teams with the data foundation they need to reach their full potential and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain the Data Lake architecture, building scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Databricks workflows, Delta Lake, and Apache Spark to ensure efficient data movement and storage across the organization.
Leverage Databricks platform capabilities including jobs, clusters, and Unity Catalog to create robust data processing workflows that handle large-scale datasets (terabytes to petabytes), ensuring high performance, reliability, and data quality throughout the data lifecycle.
Implement data ingestion and transformation pipelines within Databricks, utilizing Spark SQL and PySpark to process streaming and batch data from various sources into the Data Lake.
Build and optimize change data capture (CDC) solutions using Debezium and other technologies to enable real-time data synchronization and streaming between heterogeneous database systems and the Databricks Data Lake.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders on a daily basis to understand data requirements and translate business needs into technical data solutions within the Databricks environment that support analytics and decision-making.
Design and implement data models, schemas, and Delta Lake table structures to support efficient data storage, retrieval, and analysis, following medallion architecture patterns (bronze, silver, gold layers) within Databricks.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Databricks cluster performance and data pipeline efficiency, proactively identifying and resolving data quality issues, bottlenecks, and system failures to maintain SLA requirements.
Establish and enforce data engineering best practices, coding standards, and documentation for Databricks development to ensure maintainability, scalability, and knowledge transfer across the team.
Mentor junior members of the team on work practices and tech stack.
Participate in architecture decisions and technology evaluations, recommending Databricks features, configurations, and integration approaches that align with organizational data strategy and technical roadmap.
Implement data security and governance measures within Databricks and the Data Lake to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies, including access controls, encryption, and audit logging.
Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related technical roles working with large-scale data systems.
Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines that process large volumes of data (multi-terabyte to petabyte scale).
2 years of hands-on experience with Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Databricks workflows, notebooks, and cluster management.
Strong proficiency in Apache Spark and distributed data processing, with demonstrated experience in PySpark and/or Scala for building data pipelines.
Preferred Qualifications:
Solid understanding of data modeling principles, database design, and experience with both SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
Experience with change data capture (CDC) technologies such as Debezium, or similar streaming data integration tools.
Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (Python, Scala, or Java).
Strong understanding of data lake architectures, including medallion architecture patterns (bronze, silver, gold layers).
Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

AI Product Strategy for EIT: Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered products within EIT, with a focus on Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy, and HR functions, including the integration of LLMs. Align these strategies with Nielsens overall business goals, with a strong emphasis on governance and ethical considerations.
AI Product Lifecycle Management (EIT): Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for EIT AI products, from ideation and requirements gathering to development, launch, and iteration. Ensure timely and successful delivery of AI solutions that meet the specific needs of EIT functions, while adhering to AI governance policies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration (EIT): Collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders within EIT to translate business needs into AI product requirements. Ensure seamless integration of AI capabilities, including LLMs, into EIT workflows and systems, with a focus on compliance, security, and ethical use.
AI Use Case Identification (EIT): Identify and evaluate potential AI use cases within EIT functions, including opportunities to leverage LLMs to improve efficiency, decision-making, and user experience. Assess the feasibility, viability, and alignment of these use cases with EIT objectives and governance frameworks.
AI Product Requirements (EIT): Define and prioritize AI product requirements for EIT, including data needs, model specifications (especially for LLMs), performance metrics, and user experience considerations. Ensure that requirements address specific EIT concerns, such as data privacy, security, legal compliance, and auditability.
Ethical AI and Governance (EIT): Integrate ethical considerations and governance principles into the product development process for EIT AI products. Ensure that AI systems, including those utilizing LLMs, are developed and deployed responsibly, transparently, and in compliance with relevant regulations, with a strong emphasis on mitigating risks related to bias, fairness, and explainability in the EIT context.
Performance Monitoring and Optimization (EIT): Establish metrics and processes to monitor the performance, effectiveness, and user adoption of AI products within EIT. Drive continuous improvement and optimization, with a focus on ensuring that AI systems meet EIT-specific performance, compliance, and security requirements.
AI Literacy Program Implementation: Develop and implement an AI Literacy Program for Nielsen, aligned with EU AI Act guidelines. This includes creating training materials, delivering training sessions, and promoting AI awareness across the organization, with a focus on educating EIT staff on the responsible and ethical use of AI, including LLMs.
Collaboration with Business Functions (Governance Perspective): Collaborate with Nielsens business functions (outside of EIT) to ensure alignment of business AI product development with the overall AI governance framework. A rating of below 7.5/10 on python

LLM System Development

Prompt engineering

Function/tool calling
Chain-of-thought and structured output generation

Build conversational flows, decision trees, and fallback logic for copilots or assistants

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Create embedding pipelines (e.g., using text-embedding-ada-002, Cohere, or Sentence Transformers)

Evaluate grounding accuracy and relevance scoring

Hallucination rate
Grounding precision/recall
Prompt latency and token efficiency

Azure OpenAI Service

description:
Job Description Summary
The Data Scientist executes end-to-end Data Science and Machine Learning workflows under guidance to deliver measurable value in industrial operations. You will focus on data acquisition/cleaning, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, model development/validation, and contribute to deployment and monitoring in collaboration with data/platform engineering.
Primary use cases include time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance, with Generative AI (GenAI) as an added advantage. Exposure to operations in Oil Gas, Fossil Power, or Renewable Power is a plus
Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
Execute DS/ML tasks across the model lifecycle: data acquisition, quality assessment/cleansing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis on industrial datasets (sensor/telemetry, logs, emissions, maintenance) with reproducible workflows.
Train, tune, and validate models (regression, classification, and time-series methods such as ARIMA/Prophet; anomaly detection; ensembles). Document experiments and results clearly.
Collaborate with data/platform engineering to contribute to data pipelines and model serving; support deployment activities and basic monitoring/drift checks under supervision.
Produce clean, well-structured Python/SQL code; follow coding standards, version control, and experiment tracking practices.
Create visual analyses and concise summaries to communicate findings and recommendations to teammates and stakeholders; incorporate feedback to iterate.
Assist in measuring outcomes against success metrics (e.g., reliability, availability, efficiency, emissions, cost) and maintain project artifacts (reports, annotated code).
Learn industrial context, data sources, and domain constraints; proactively identify data quality issues and propose fixes within established procedures.
Participate in POCs/pilots, including GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics workflows (analytics automation, documentation) as an added advantage.
Education Qualification For roles outside USA:
Bachelor''s Degree in Computer Science or STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with minimum 3 years of experience in Data Science/Machine Learning or closely related roles.
For roles in USA:
Bachelor''s Degree in Computer Science or STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with minimum 3 years of experience.
Desired Characteristics
Technical Expertise:
Proficient in Python and SQL; hands-on with Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; basic exposure to TensorFlow/PyTorch is a plus.
Applied experience with feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, and performance measurement for time-series and classification/regression problems.
Solid foundations in data management: ETL basics, data quality checks/cleansing, and working with large datasets.
Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI) and MLOps concepts (experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring) is a plus.
Competent in visual analytics for EDA and communicating insights; experience with dashboards or notebooks preferred.
Familiarity with big data/streaming technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka) and real-time analytics considerations is a plus.
Domain Knowledge:
Exposure to industrial operations (Oil Gas, Fossil Power, Renewable Power) is a plus; ability to learn failure modes, maintenance strategies, and process constraints and translate them into features and validation criteria.
Basic understanding of business drivers and operational KPIs (availability, MTBF/MTTR, throughput, energy yield, emissions, cost) with the ability to connect analytical results to business value.
Leadership:
Operates within established procedures with some autonomy; collaborates effectively with direct colleagues and seeks guidance for issues outside defined parameters.
Applies structured problem solving and analytical thinking; proposes improvements within set practices.
Builds strong working relationships; may guide interns or junior teammates on routine tasks.
Personal Attributes:
Curiosity and continuous learning mindset; connects ideas and incorporates feedback quickly.
Comfort in ambiguity at project/task level; states assumptions clearly and adapts based on new information.
Clear communicator; explains technical information to teammates and stakeholders and asks clarifying questions to ensure shared understanding.

As a Machine Learning Engineer with 4 to 8 years of experience, your role would primarily involve designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and algorithms to solve real-world problems. Designing and Building Models: Develop and build machine learning models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, NLP, computer vision) tailored to business problems or research questions.
Algorithm Selection: Choose appropriate algorithms and techniques based on the specific problem, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, or reinforcement learning.
Model Evaluation: Evaluate models for performance using various metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, AUC-ROC, F1-score, etc.) and ensure the models generalize well to unseen data.
Feature Engineering: Collaborate with data scientists and other engineers to create meaningful features from raw data that improve model performance.

Data Cleaning and Transformation: Handle data preprocessing, including cleaning (handling missing values, outliers) and transforming data into suitable formats for modeling.

Productionizing Models: Deploy machine learning models into production environments using cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
Scalability: Ensure that ML models are scalable, handling large datasets efficiently and maintaining performance under varying loads.
Monitoring: Continuously monitor model performance after deployment, ensuring models remain accurate over time (detecting concept drift, recalibrating models, etc.).
Model Optimization: Tune hyperparameters, optimize models for better performance, and improve the efficiency of model inference.
4. Collaboration and Communication
Cross-Functional Teamwork: Work closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to align machine learning models with business objectives.
Stakeholder Communication: Present complex ML concepts, results, and model insights in a clear, understandable manner to non-technical stakeholders and decision-makers.

description:
Primary Title : Senior LLM Engineer (4+ years) - Hybrid, India.

About The Opportunity :

A technology consulting firm operating at the intersection of Enterprise AI, Generative AI and Cloud Engineering seeks an experienced LLM-focused engineer.

You will build and productionize LLM-powered products and integrations for enterprise customers across knowledge management, search, automation, and conversational AI use-cases.

This is a hybrid role based in India for candidates with strong hands-on LLM engineering experience.

Role & Responsibilities :

- Own design and implementation of end-to-end LLM solutions : data ingestion / retrieval (RAG) / fine-tuning / inference and monitoring for production workloads.

- Develop robust Python microservices to serve LLM inference, retrieval, and agentic workflows using LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent toolkits.

- Implement and optimise vector search pipelines (FAISS/Pinecone/Milvus), embedding generation, chunking strategies, and relevance tuning for sub-second retrieval.

- Perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/adapters) and evaluation workflows; manage model versioning and automated validation for quality and safety.

- Containerise and deploy models and services with Docker and Kubernetes; integrate with cloud infra (AWS/Azure/GCP) and CI/CD for repeatable delivery.

- Establish observability, alerting, and performance SLAs for LLM services; collaborate with cross-functional teams to define success metrics and iterate rapidly.

Must-Have :

- 4+ years engineering experience with 2+ years working directly on LLM/Generative AI projects.

- Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch and HuggingFace/transformers libraries.

- Practical experience building RAG pipelines, vector search (FAISS/Pinecone/Milvus), and embedding workflows.

- Experience with fine-tuning strategies (LoRA/adapters) and evaluation frameworks for model quality and safety.

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP), and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

- Solid understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval strategies, and production monitoring of ML services.

Preferred :

- Experience with LangChain/LangGraph, agent frameworks, or building tool-calling pipelines.

- Exposure to MLOps platforms, model registry, autoscaling low-latency inference, and cost-optimisation techniques.

- Background in productionising LLMs for enterprise use-cases (knowledge bases, search, virtual assistants).

Benefits & Culture Highlights :

- Hybrid work model with flexible in-office collaboration and remote days; competitive market compensation.

- Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise AI initiatives and shape production-grade GenAI patterns across customers.

- Learning-first culture : access to technical mentorship, experimentation environments, and conferences/learning stipend.

description:

Data Scientist role at Nablon is crucial in bridging the gap between AI experimentation and production-grade deployment. Design, build, and deploy machine learning and deep learning solutions that yield measurable business outcomes in production environments.

4 to 8 years of experience in data science or a related field.

Joining Nablon means becoming part of a forward-thinking team that prioritizes outcomes and innovation. What youll do...
About the team
The Information Security team has the herculean task of assuring that customers can safely shop with peace of mind knowing their data and information will be safe and secure. Solving some of the most unique cyber security problems in the industry, our team members share an elevated level of creativity and ingenuity to secure data for the largest retail operation in the world. Endpoint Security Engineering team is looking for Staff Engineer, who has passion in designing and development of software product and services in area of cyber security. Ideal candidates should have strong background in technology and security awareness. Lead the secure design and development of scalable applications and services, partnering closely with product, platform, and engineering teams.
Architect and implement Endpoint Security solutions, translating security requirements into robust, production-grade systems.
Develop high-quality solutions using Java, Go, Python, and React, leveraging both relational and non-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra).
Serve as a technical leader and mentor, collaborating with security engineers, external teams, and partners to deliver features in an agile, fast-paced environment.
Drive end-to-end ownership of services, including deployment, operations, monitoring, reliability, reporting, and analytics.
Influence security architecture and best practices across teams, ensuring solutions align with business needs, compliance requirements, and evolving threat landscapes.
What You ll bring
10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating highly scalable, distributed applications and security platforms.
Deep hands-on expertise in Java, Python or Go, with strong engineering fundamentals and a security-first mindset.
Strong experience building modern services using Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, JavaScript, React, and Node.js.
Proven experience designing and deploying multi-tier, cloud-native applications in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Demonstrated ability to create and review solution designs, integration flows, component architectures, and data models.
Solid hands-on experience with SQL, database design, and ORM frameworks, across both relational and NoSQL systems.

Working knowledge of Endpoint Security concepts, such as endpoint telemetry, agent-based architectures, device trust, policy enforcement, and secure communications.

Strong Linux fundamentals, including system-level troubleshooting and security hardening.
Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and building secure, resilient systems at scale.
Proven track record of driving secure-by-design architectures and embedding application and endpoint security controls into the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, including automated security testing and policy enforcement.
Ability to influence across teams, balancing security, usability, performance, and business requirements.
Passion for building high-impact security solutions that operate reliably at enterprise scale.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and self-direction, with the ability to lead through ambiguity.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex security and risk concepts into clear business and engineering guidance.
Holding security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, GIAC certifications, or Cloud Security certifications is a strong plus, but not required

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
Flexible work
Walmart s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
Benefits

Belonging
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is and feels included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being inclusive of all people.
